bio_en: Virab Melkonian-Dalyants was born in 1866 in Pip village in the Ganja district and threw himself into the new movement of the 1890s, his home becoming a meeting place for comrades. When Hakob the deacon of Taron came to the Caucasus after the 1890 Karin events, he joined Sargis Kukunian's expedition, and on 26 September 1890 was arrested with Kukunian near Khar village in Kaghzvan. Chained in Kars prison until 1892 and tried in Tiflis in 1893, he and his comrades were sentenced as common criminals. Moved by the news of the massacres of 1896-98 he set out again, and he died in Persia on 3 May 1900, aged 34.
